title: Standing order: {item} for the {workshop}
The furnace wants feeding
summary: The {workshop} of {settlement} keeps a standing order for {goods}: {count} × {item}, paid above market, every time.
{giver} takes all the {item} anyone brings to the {workshop}: {count} wanted now.
offer: A furnace eats day and night, and our {goods} is nearly gone. Bring me {count} × {item} and there is coin in it — today, next week, whenever the stack runs low.
I will take {count} × {item} off your hands at a good price, and the same again whenever the bins run low.
complete: That will keep the fire going a while. Come back when the bins run low.
Good. The order stands, if you find more.
